Imaad Abbasi is a Pakistani-American from the outskirts of Chicago, Illinois. His parents came to the US at a young age and taught him about Islamic culture, immigration reform, and the international world. He is currently at GW studying Economics and Political Science with a Public Policy focus, minoring in Data Science. He likes to play guitar, learn Spanish, and write about politics in his free time.
